newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech CNB fixes crown 32.233/USD, 18.710/mark.
newsitem.headline: Czech CNB fixes crown 32.233/USD, 18.710/mark.

text.p: The Czech National Bank (CNB) fixed the crown on Thursday at 32.233 to the dollar after Wedneseday's fixing at 32.129, and at 18.710 to the mark from 18.760.
The rates correspond roughly with the levels on the interbank market at 11.30 a.m. (0930 gmt) when the central bank calculates its daily fixing.

On May 27, the central bank eliminated its fluctuation band within which it would fix the crown up to plus/minus 7.5 percent of a mark/dollar basket. It now uses the fixing as a daily reference point reflecting the market.
